title: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-NOTEBOOK-01)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: The working notebook of an investigation into the relation between the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, kept append-forward across fifty-four rounds (§§1–248) and three framings (the Snub; the Ratified Break; the Calibration Object and the Future Reader), with a Standing Frame. It records readings, measurements, retractions and voids in the order they happened: the σιμ- locus and its refutation by base rate (R1–R2); the κερματισμός/σύμβολον structure (R9, Part II); the six-function transmission apparatus and its rivals (R12–R13); the object-conditioning parity and its Aquinas correction (R18–R19); the school rival measured three ways and voided as an operator test (R24, R28–R30); the lexical battery and every control that killed it (R31–R39); the attestation audit and the Protagoras control that went against it (R40–R43); the calibration correction (R44); the comedy-and-tragedy structure (R45); the Cicero parsimony (R46); the coverage anomaly (R47); the ranking (R48); the two questions (R49); the ladder (R50); the arithmetic (R51); the reading precept and the seam (R52); the salvage of the earlier paper (R53); the comic layer (R54). The notebook is the maximal form of the investigation's record. It is not a paper, makes no argument in its own voice, and is deposited so that every number and reading in the derivative papers can be traced to the round and section that produced it, with the retraction attached where one was made. A later correction to R54 §245 (the Clouds 'relabelling' result, a counting artifact: the 40/38 were speaker labels) is recorded in the derivative reading copy and is to be appended here as R55.

wiki_article: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation (EA-NOTEBOOK-01) is the working record of a multi-month investigation into the relation between the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, kept append-forward across fifty-four rounds and three framings, with nothing erased. It is not a paper and makes no argument in its own voice: it records readings, measurements, retractions and voids in the order they occurred, so that every number and reading in the derived papers can be traced to the round and section that produced it, with any refutation attached where one was made. The rounds run from the snub locus and its refutation by its own base rate (R1–R2), through the fragmentation and symbolon structure (R9), the six-function transmission apparatus and its rival specifications (R12–R13), the object-conditioning parity and its correction (R18–R19), the school rival measured three ways and then voided as an operator test (R24, R28–R30), the lexical battery and every control that killed it (R31–R39), the attestation audit and the control that went against it (R40–R43), the comedy-and-tragedy structure (R45), the coverage anomaly (R47), the ladder (R50), the arithmetic of the four propositions (R51) and the comic layer of the accusation (R54). Its discipline is stated in its own pages: the ordinary reading first and in full, every result travelling with its limit, and a number not in the file did not happen. Companions are the measurement register (EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01), which holds the figures with their conditions, and the frozen pre-registration ledger, which holds what was fixed before each test. The notebook is deposited as the maximal form of the investigation's record; a later correction to Round 54 §245 — the Clouds relabelling result, found to be a counting artifact — is to be appended as a subsequent round rather than edited in, which is what append-forward means.

entities.subject: σιμ- locus
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The philological locus defined by forty-eight tokens of the snub-nose lexeme (σιμός, σιμότης, σιμόν, σιμή, σιμότερος) across the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora, fixed with positional data as a candidate recognition key.

entities.subject: terminal-to-initial term transfer
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The class of terms that appear near the end (terminal position) of one corpus and are taken up at the beginning (initial position) of another, proposed as a measurable pattern of inter-corpus intellectual uptake.

entities.subject: enmattered form
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: Aristotle's canonical case (τὸ σιμόν) of a form whose λόγος cannot be stated without its matter (ὕλη), as opposed to concavity (κοῖλον) which can be defined apart from matter.

entities.subject: recognition criterion
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The principle derived from the snub locus: what persists across substrates is the λόγος; what individuates is the ὕλη; therefore a form is recognised by its account and not by its instance.

entities.subject: configurational reading
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: An interpretive hypothesis, explicitly marked as the central difficulty of the investigation, that the Platonic and Aristotelian corpora form a single deliberate configuration rather than works of independent authors.

entities.subject: κερματισμός
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: Plato's standing metaphor for the fragmentation of unity into many small parts, from κέρμα (small coin), used in the investigation to ground the denial that one maker can hold two arts.

entities.subject: σύμβολον structure
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The structure in which a deliberate break (rather than accidental fragmentation) produces a token recognisable at its fracture line, used to reframe κερματισμός as a method rather than a wound.

entities.subject: Ratified Break
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The reconstruction in which the involuntary fragmentation of human nature (κερματισμός) is converted into a deliberate, credential-producing division — heteronymy as a procedure that satisfies both the Republic's denial and the Symposium's demand.

entities.subject: αὐτεπιτακτική
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: A term coined by Plato at Statesman 260d–e for the self-commanding art — a genus whose criterion is issuing commands from oneself rather than relaying another's mind — left with its sub-genera unentered.

entities.subject: naming-gap reflex
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The procedural habit, measured at M30, of halting at an unnamed class, flagging the absence of a name, and coining a term — shared by Plato and Aristotle at 9.4× the rate of other high-division authors.

entities.subject: calibration object
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The hypothesis that the Platonic–Aristotelian corpus served as a known-answer test case on which the ancient authenticity apparatus (Pinakes, obelus, stichometric checksums) was fitted and developed.

entities.subject: adversarial object
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The corrected framing of the calibration object hypothesis: the corpus was built to defeat the best available measures of authenticity rather than to train them.

entities.subject: the flood
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The adversarial condition reframing the investigation: not the examiner but the oversupply of writing and scarcity of copying resources that caused merit-indifferent drowning of texts.

entities.subject: Obelus Principle
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: The archive's own principle, named from Aristarchus's obelus, that a suspected element should be marked without deletion so that mark and text travel together.

entities.subject: aporia-to-closure ratio
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: A per-work measurement (per 10⁴ tokens) of how often a dialogue reaches an aporetic versus a resolved conclusion, used to characterise argumentative mode across the Platonic corpus.

entities.subject: reporting-formula density
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: A measurement of narrated dialogue tokens (ἦν δ᾽ ἐγώ, ἦ δ᾽ ὅς, ἔφη, ἔφην, εἶπον) per 10⁴ tokens used to classify Platonic works by mimetic mode.

entities.subject: seam vocabulary
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: Technical-term profile cosine similarity between two works, used to test whether they engage the same problem in shared or disjoint vocabulary — a 'tiling' signal when low.

entities.subject: symbolon test
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: A three-check test (seam vocabulary, argumentative mode, declared relation) applied to a pair of works to assess whether they stand as complementary halves of a deliberate split.

entities.subject: verdict density / verdict decisiveness / verdict stability
entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: Three pre-specified components of the discriminating test for the calibration-object hypothesis: respectively, attributed judgements per work, proportion of judgements citing stated grounds, and reversal rate across antiquity.

entities.object: The Notebook of the Authorship Investigation: Fifty-Four Rounds, Append-Forward, Nothing Erased (EA-
entities.note: A persistent framing section of the notebook maintained across all rounds to contextualise and govern the append-forward record.
